clauses.text:
I hereby establish the following order
for the Canal Zone governing Corozal Hospital , amending the Executive Order
promulgated May 10, 1911, to read as follows :

clauses.label: Sec . 1.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 1. The Panama Canal asylum for the insane shall be at Corozal Hospital ,
under the jurisdiction of the Health Department . Its object shall be the shelter
and curative treatment of the insane .

clauses.label: Sec . 2.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 2. The Superintendent of Corozal Hospital shall be the administrative chief
of the asylum , subject to existing laws and orders and to such rules and regulations
as may be issued by the Health Department in accordance with existing laws and
orders . He shall have the supervision over the professional and administrative
personnel of the asylum and over the inmates , and he shall satisfy himself that all
patients receive the care and medical treatment which are best adapted to their
comfort and recovery .
He shall see that a proper register of each patient is kept , showing name ,
previous residence , occupation, origin and antecedents , and condition at the time
of admission ; and he shall keep a record of their mental and physical condition , as
well as the medical treatment they receive during the time of their stay in the
asylum . The death or discharge of patients shall be entered in the register .

clauses.label: Sec . 3.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 3. No person declared to be insane shall be kept in jail, prison, hospital
for the sick, or other similar institution , except on written authority of the Super￾intendent of Corozal Hospital , which authority shall state the reason therefor .

clauses.label: Sec . 4.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 4. Except as provided for in sections 14 and 15, no person shall be admitted
as a patient in the asylum for the insane except upon the order of the District
Judge of the Canal Zone , provided that if a patient is in a state of violent insanity
he may be admitted at once by the Superintendent of Corozal Hospital , without an
order from the Court, into the quarters provided for the observation of persons
alleged to be insane , upon the written request of any physician employed by the
United States Government ; or such patient may be admitted to the observation
quarters by said Superintendent upon his own authority .
It shall be the duty of the Superintendent of Corozal Hospital to file a written
report with the Clerk of the District Court within twenty -four hours after the patient
has been admitted to the observation quarters , which report shall set out the name ,
age , and physical condition of patient, together with name of physician attending
patient at time of admittance, and as soon as the clerk shall have received the
report , he shall enter it upon the docket and the District Judge shall proceed to
examine and determine the case in like manner as if the petition had been presented
to him prior to the patient's admission into observation quarters .

clauses.label: Sec . 5.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 5. To obtain the judicial order provided for in the preceding section , it
shall be necessary for the nearest relative of the person alleged to be insane to
present a petition , duly subscribed and sworn to by the petitioner , to the Judge of
the District Court of the Canal Zone , which petition shall state the sex, age , and
nationality of patient , if known , and the facts showing patient's mental infirmity ,
and , if possible , the history of the case and the form of insanity with which he is
suffering and the attending circumstances making it necessary that he be confined
in the asylum. The petition shall be accompanied by a certificate signed by one
or more reputable physicians to the effect that such person is insane .
 
2
When the nearest relatives of the person alleged to be insane are absent or
refuse to act , the petition may be made by any person residing within the Canal
Zone , and in that event the petitioner shall state that the nearest relatives of
the
patient are absent or refuse
toact .

Sec .
6.

clauses.text:
Sec .
6.
The petition provided for
inthe preceding section shall take precedence
over all other matters pending before the court and shall be heard by the Judge
thereof without delay ,and
if

of

of

to
be
confined ,
he shall issue orders
at
once
directing that the person alleged
tobe insane be taken
incustody for observation .

said order that ,
if
the observation shall show that the patient

heshall

liberty
at once ,and the Superintendent
of Corozal Hospital shall forthwith
report his action thereon
tothe Judge who issued the order .
The observation
of
the alleged insane person shall be made
insuitable quarters
within the asylum grounds by the Superintendent
of Corozal Hospital ,
or under
his
direction ,and shall
be
for aperiod
of not more than thirty days ,and the Judge who
issues the order for the detention
of
the patient shall require the Superintendent
to
make reports thereon . It
shall
be
the duty
of
the physician
incharge
of
the observation
to
examine
the patient and observe the symptoms
of
the case .
Within thirty days after
the
patient

placed under observation ,
the Superintendent shall make a
report
in
writing ,

is
sane
or
insane ;
the report shall contain a
statement
of
the facts upon which the opinion

clauses.label:
Sec .
8.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec .
8.
It
shall be the duty
of
the Court
to
render final judgment therein ,
either committing the patient
tothe asylum ,
or
ordering his discharge ,
ordirecting
that he be turned over
to
his relatives who are able and willing
totake care
of him .

clauses.label:
Sec .
9.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec .
9.
The relatives
of
the person alleged
tobe insane ,
or the District Attorney ,
may appear and contest the report
of
the Superintendent ,and
insuch cases the
Judge shall hear the evidence presented by the parties and render judgment thereon , asprovided insection eight .

clauses.label:
Sec .
10.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec .
10. Any person interested
in
aninmate
of
the asylum ,who believes such
inmate
is
improperly detained therein ,may make application
to
the District Judge
for the discharge
of such patient .
Upon receipt
of such application the Judge shall
issue an order
to
the Superintendent ,Corozal Hospital ,
tomake a
report
on
the
patient's condition ,and upon the receipt
of such report shall consider the case ,
and ,
in
his discretion ,may grant
ordeny the application .
The Judge may cause
the
patient
to
be
examined by two competent physicians who shall report
inwriting
as
to
the condition
of
the patient .

clauses.label:
Sec .
11.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec .
11. Apatient serving a
sentence for the violation
of
the criminal laws
of
the Canal Zone shall
bedischarged from the Hospital upon the order
of the District
Court .
All other patients may
be
discharged by the Superintendent .
Heshall
file with the clerk
of the court awritten statement that
inhis judgment such patient
has recovered ,
or
that the discharge will not
be
detrimental
or
dangerous
to
the
public welfare
or
injurious
to
the patient ,
provided that before discharging any
patient who has not recovered ,
the Superintendent shall satisfy himself by adequate
investigation that the relatives
or
friends
of
the patient are able and willing
to
receive and care for such patient .
No patient shall
bedischarged from the Hospital without suitable clothing .

clauses.label:
Sec .
12.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec .
12.
If
any person confined
in
aprison
orpenitentiary under the sentence
of
acourt becomes insane ,
he
shall
be
committed
tothe asylum for the insane
by
the Judge
of
the District Court .
In
all
such cases the provisions
of
this order
 
21

3
relating to the period of observation of the patient and the trial of the issue as to
his insanity shall be observed . Whenever a person is committed to the insane
asylum under the provisions of this section , the order of commitment issued by the
court shall include a statement of the offense of which the person was convicted,
the term of his imprisonment and the date upon which said term is to expire .
Should such person be discharged from the insane asylum before the date of the
expiration of his term of imprisonment, he shall be returned to the penal institution
from which he was taken.

clauses.label: Sec . 13.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 13. Nothing contained in this order shall be construed to repeal or modify
the provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the Canal Zone relating to the
inquiry into the insanity of the defendants before trial or after conviction .

clauses.label: Sec . 14.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 14. Insane patients from the Republic of Panama may be admitted into
the asylum for the insane in accordance with the existing agreements between the
Canal Zone authorities and the Panaman authorities, or under such changes and
modifications of said agreement as may be made from time to time .

clauses.label: Sec. 15.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec. 15. The Superintendent of Corozal Hospital is authorized to receive as
patients, members of the Army , Navy, and Marine Corps , for observation and care
pending their transfer to the United States , upon the order of the Commanding
General of the Panama Canal Department , United States Army, or the Comman￾dant of the 15th Naval District of the United States Navy , or other competent naval
authority in the case of naval vessels in Canal Zone waters which are not under the
jurisdiction of the 15th Naval District .

clauses.label: Sec . 16.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 16. The Governor of The Panama Canal is hereby authorized to make
rules and regulations necessary for the carrying out of the provisions of this order .

clauses.label: Sec . 17.

source.page_or_item: HathiTrust hvd.hl271z (GPO bound Executive orders, title range 4560-5018), PDF pages 949-952

clauses.text:
Sec . 17. This order shall take effect thirty days from this date .
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
a November 3 , 1928 .
[No. 4988 ]

Executive Order
FOR THE
GOVERNMENT OF COROZAL HOSPITAL
By virtue of the authority vested in me I hereby establish the following order
for the Canal Zone governing Corozal Hospital , amending the Executive Order
promulgated May 10, 1911, to read as follows :
Sec . 1. The Panama Canal asylum for the insane shall be at Corozal Hospital ,
under the jurisdiction of the Health Department . Its object shall be the shelter
and curative treatment of the insane .
Sec . 2. The Superintendent of Corozal Hospital shall be the administrative chief
of the asylum , subject to existing laws and orders and to such rules and regulations
as may be issued by the Health Department in accordance with existing laws and
orders . He shall have the supervision over the professional and administrative
personnel of the asylum and over the inmates , and he shall satisfy himself that all
patients receive the care and medical treatment which are best adapted to their
comfort and recovery .
He shall see that a proper register of each patient is kept , showing name ,
previous residence , occupation, origin and antecedents , and condition at the time
of admission ; and he shall keep a record of their mental and physical condition , as
well as the medical treatment they receive during the time of their stay in the
asylum . The death or discharge of patients shall be entered in the register .
Sec . 3. No person declared to be insane shall be kept in jail, prison, hospital
for the sick, or other similar institution , except on written authority of the Super￾intendent of Corozal Hospital , which authority shall state the reason therefor .
Sec . 4. Except as provided for in sections 14 and 15, no person shall be admitted
as a patient in the asylum for the insane except upon the order of the District
Judge of the Canal Zone , provided that if a patient is in a state of violent insanity
he may be admitted at once by the Superintendent of Corozal Hospital , without an
order from the Court, into the quarters provided for the observation of persons
alleged to be insane , upon the written request of any physician employed by the
United States Government ; or such patient may be admitted to the observation
quarters by said Superintendent upon his own authority .
It shall be the duty of the Superintendent of Corozal Hospital to file a written
report with the Clerk of the District Court within twenty -four hours after the patient
has been admitted to the observation quarters , which report shall set out the name ,
age , and physical condition of patient, together with name of physician attending
patient at time of admittance, and as soon as the clerk shall have received the
report , he shall enter it upon the docket and the District Judge shall proceed to
examine and determine the case in like manner as if the petition had been presented
to him prior to the patient's admission into observation quarters .
Sec . 5. To obtain the judicial order provided for in the preceding section , it
shall be necessary for the nearest relative of the person alleged to be insane to
present a petition , duly subscribed and sworn to by the petitioner , to the Judge of
the District Court of the Canal Zone , which petition shall state the sex, age , and
nationality of patient , if known , and the facts showing patient's mental infirmity ,
and , if possible , the history of the case and the form of insanity with which he is
suffering and the attending circumstances making it necessary that he be confined
in the asylum. The petition shall be accompanied by a certificate signed by one
or more reputable physicians to the effect that such person is insane .
 
2
When the nearest relatives of the person alleged to be insane are absent or
refuse to act , the petition may be made by any person residing within the Canal
Zone , and in that event the petitioner shall state that the nearest relatives of
the
patient are absent or refuse
toact .

over all other matters pending before the court and shall be heard by the Judge

if

of

at

The observation

within the asylum grounds by the Superintendent

or under

of

Within thirty days after

the report shall contain a

Sec .

It

to

either committing the patient
tothe asylum ,
or
ordering his discharge ,
ordirecting

relating to the period of observation of the patient and the trial of the issue as to
his insanity shall be observed . Whenever a person is committed to the insane
asylum under the provisions of this section , the order of commitment issued by the
court shall include a statement of the offense of which the person was convicted,
the term of his imprisonment and the date upon which said term is to expire .
Should such person be discharged from the insane asylum before the date of the
expiration of his term of imprisonment, he shall be returned to the penal institution
from which he was taken.
Sec . 13. Nothing contained in this order shall be construed to repeal or modify
the provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the Canal Zone relating to the
inquiry into the insanity of the defendants before trial or after conviction .
Sec . 14. Insane patients from the Republic of Panama may be admitted into
the asylum for the insane in accordance with the existing agreements between the
Canal Zone authorities and the Panaman authorities, or under such changes and
modifications of said agreement as may be made from time to time .
Sec. 15. The Superintendent of Corozal Hospital is authorized to receive as
patients, members of the Army , Navy, and Marine Corps , for observation and care
pending their transfer to the United States , upon the order of the Commanding
General of the Panama Canal Department , United States Army, or the Comman￾dant of the 15th Naval District of the United States Navy , or other competent naval
authority in the case of naval vessels in Canal Zone waters which are not under the
jurisdiction of the 15th Naval District .
Sec . 16. The Governor of The Panama Canal is hereby authorized to make
rules and regulations necessary for the carrying out of the provisions of this order .
Sec . 17. This order shall take effect thirty days from this date .
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
a November 3 , 1928 .
